div.div:
الفَلْقَةُ A certain brand, beneath the ear of a camel, (O, K,) in the form of a ring in the middle of which is a perpendicular line dividing it [from top to bottom, and, in some copies of the K, extending downwards so that about half of its length is below the ring]. (O, K. * [In some copies of the latter it is figured, but somewhat differently in different copies.]) ―
-b2- See also فَلَقَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
